subject.title: [Feature]: Async voice notes in the mobile chat composer (record and send as audio attachment)

question: Should OpenClaw proceed with async voice-note recording in the first-party iOS and Android chat composers as the scoped v1 described by the linked platform PRs?
rationale: The request is roadmap-aligned and the server path already exists, but the protected maintainer label, cross-platform UX, microphone ownership, and proof requirements are product choices automation should not settle.

options.title: Review scoped mobile v1
options.body: Proceed with the linked iOS and Android PRs after conflict/proof cleanup, keeping server behavior on the existing attachment/media-understanding path.

options.title: Pilot one platform first
options.body: Land or refine one platform first to validate recorder UX and mic coordination before approving the second platform.

options.title: Defer voice notes
options.body: Leave first-party mobile users on Talk mode, typing, or third-party channel voice notes until mobile composer voice input is prioritized later.

recommendation.title: Review scoped mobile v1
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked iOS and Android PRs after conflict/proof cleanup, keeping server behavior on the existing attachment/media-understanding path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the issue, authored the active platform candidate commits, and appears in current sampled blame for the affected composer/gateway paths.
